title: Students protest outside Hyderabad college after classmate suicide

tea.why: Students protested outside their college in Hyderabad following the suicide of a fellow student.
tea.want: Protesters demanded an impartial inquiry into the student's death and action against those responsible.
tea.changed: Nov 8: Police arrested the college principal and a lecturer for abetment of suicide.

summary: Following the death by suicide of a second-year student at a hotel management college in SR Nagar, Hyderabad, fellow students staged a demonstration outside the institution. The protesters alleged that harassment by the college principal drove the student to take his own life. They demanded an impartial inquiry into the incident and punitive action against those deemed responsible. In response to the situation and subsequent police investigations, authorities arrested the college principal and a lecturer under Section 108 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, placing them into judicial remand.
demands: An impartial inquiry into the student's death
response: According to SR Nagar police, the college principal and a lecturer were arrested under Section 108 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and remanded to judicial custody following an investigation.

updates.text: Fellow students staged a protest outside Amrutha Hotel Management College in SR Nagar following a student's suicide.
SR Nagar police announced the arrest of the college principal and a lecturer for abetment of suicide.
